decision: Adopt this additive summary repair before interpreting future F4 residence/contact outputs. It fixes denominator semantics; it does not repair the observed reconstruction-gate failure or establish material reliability.

evidence.finding: The existing summary applies final reliability to contact/CDF masks but not to residence_mean_s, while right_censored_fraction also excludes final unknown paths. This makes contact_fraction=0 with positive residence_mean_s mathematically possible but easy to misread, and makes unresolved unknown mass appear as right_censored_fraction=0.

frozen_semantics_to_preserve.contact: first downward crossing from z>0.18 to z<=0.18 after t=0 with vertical velocity <0
frozen_semantics_to_preserve.return: first later downward crossing after upward with vertical velocity <0
frozen_semantics_to_preserve.upward: first upward crossing after contact with vertical velocity >0

implementation_boundary.candidate_target: versioned summary schema/function only; do not alter frozen runner or terminal traces

legacy_compatibility.legacy_right_censored_fraction_note: do not interpret as unresolved mass until replaced by event_unresolved_fraction

minimal_validation.assert: history fraction=final reliable contact fraction=1; observed mean is finite; unresolved fraction=0
history fraction=.5; final reliable contact fraction=0; partial residence lower bound >0; unresolved fraction=1; observed mean=null
minimal_validation.case: one contacted then unknown, one never contacted and unknown

minimal_validation.assert: history fraction=0; partial residence lower bound=0; unresolved fraction=1; all event CDFs unresolved/NA
minimal_validation.case: all unknown with no event history

proposed_additive_fields.contact_history_fraction: weighted(contacted) / source_mass; known historical contact even if the path later becomes unknown
proposed_additive_fields.event_cdf_status: complete only when the required reliable event mask is complete; otherwise unresolved/NA
proposed_additive_fields.event_unresolved_fraction: weighted(~reliable or unresolved required event) / source_mass; unknown paths are included
proposed_additive_fields.final_reliable_contact_fraction: weighted(reliable & contacted) / source_mass; the current contact_fraction under an explicit name
proposed_additive_fields.residence_observed_mean_s: weighted(residence where reliable & contacted) / weighted(reliable & contacted), or null when observed mass is zero
proposed_additive_fields.residence_partial_mean_lower_bound_s: weighted(residence over all seeds) / source_mass; current residence_mean_s renamed/documented as a lower bound while any path is unknown

purpose: Make terminal reliability and event-history denominators explicit without changing the numerical backend, support gate, unknown gate, event definitions, or existing terminal evidence.
qualification_claim: none; proposal only; no T2 implication
